```{r}
library(arrow)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)

save_path_data <- "C:/Users/DBT3KD/Desktop/Etude_macro_elec/prix_electricite_gitlab/day_ahead/outputs/fr"
setwd(save_path_data)
price_indispo_merge <- read_parquet("price_indispo_merge_fr.parquet")

```

One focusing on the different modalities I have for Unavailabilities

```{r}

price_indispo_data <- price_indispo_merge %>% 
  group_by(delivery_date) %>% 
  summarise(
    Planned = mean(Planned.Unavailable.Capacity, na.rm = TRUE),
    Published = mean(Published.Unavailable.Capacity, na.rm = TRUE),
    Uneffective = mean(Uneffective.Unavailable.Capacity, na.rm = TRUE),
    Unpublished = mean(Unpublished.Unavailable.Capacity, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

unavail_plot <- ggplot(data = price_indispo_data, aes(x= delivery_date))+
  geom_line(aes(y = Planned, color = "Planned"))+
  geom_line(aes(y = Uneffective, color = "Uneffective"))+
  geom_line(aes(y = Unpublished, color = "Unpublished"))+
  geom_line(aes(y = Published, color = "Published"))+
  labs(x= "Time", y = "Plants Unavailabilities")+
  theme_minimal()
unavail_plot 
```


```{r}
colnames(price_indispo_merge)
price_indispo_data <- price_indispo_merge %>% 
  group_by(delivery_date) %>% 
  summarise(
    Solar = mean(Solar, na.rm = TRUE),
    Wind_Offshore = mean(`Wind Offshore`, na.rm = TRUE),
    Wind_Onshore = mean(`Wind Onshore`, na.rm = TRUE),
  )
price_indispo_merge$`Wind Offshore`
renew_plot <- ggplot(data = price_indispo_data, aes(x= delivery_date))+
  geom_line(aes(y = Wind_Onshore, color = "Wind Onshore"))+
  geom_line(aes(y = Solar, color = "Solar"))+
  geom_line(aes(y = Wind_Offshore, color = "Wind Offshore"))+
  labs(x= "Time", y = "Renewable Generation")+
  theme_minimal()
renew_plot
```
